svg.title: Figure 2b. Free-space saturable absorption
svg.desc: Proposed reflective activation after the temporal sum of a full FFN Matmul. The left-hand dispersion-plane section traces four adjacent comb lines from fiber 0. Each of the eight fibers has a three-port optical circulator. Light from port 1 exits port 2 toward the fiber array, collimator and transmission grating. A common focusing lens brings each wavelength to a separate spot on a reflective saturable absorber. Solid and dashed rays show incidence and reflection in the same folded relay. The grating remultiplexes the reflected comb into its original fiber, and port 2 routes to port 3. Both miniature spectra use the same illustrative power scale. The uncalibrated spot-reflectance curve shows the illustrative saturating response used for these spectra. The front view shows the orthogonal spatial imaging axis as eight fiber rows, with comb lines 0–3 and 63 visible. The intervening columns are omitted. The continuous mirror has 8 × 64 = 512 nominal spot locations, each for one complex vector entry. Wavelength colors, optical powers, angles and spacing are illustrative.
